metaDescription: Order custom faux leather lanyards in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for ID badges and events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Faux leather lanyards offer a sophisticated look that standard nylon or polyester options can't match. They're ideal for corporate events, trade shows, or employee ID badges where you want a premium feel without the cost of genuine leather. The soft, durable material resists cracking and holds up to daily wear. Choose from multiple widths and attachment options, including badge reels or bulldog clips. Add your logo with debossing or screen printing for a polished, professional finish.
